title: watch: the evals on live telemetry, and drift as a task
summary: architect watch --env <name> [--source file|axiom] [--since 1h]: the evals telemetry alone can answer (answer shape, declared errors, steps, performance, explainability; not coverage) over an environment's recorded traffic, read through the TraceSource seam (window) from the Collector's files or from Axiom's query API (APL on <group>-traces, query token read by name). It prints each operation's p95 against its budget, the refusals by name and code, the defects and the drift; an operation over budget on at least 20 calls is drift and becomes a task file under .architect/tasks/. Prove's own calls are told apart by their caller span id and left out. tools/watch/replay.sh drives staging traffic.
proves: On a real staging world, 30 replayed spends and 3 refusals print allowance.spend p95 within its 150ms budget, AllowanceExceeded 3 and drift none; after the author's slow-spend fixture is built, proved in test, promoted and replayed, the same line is over budget with a mark of fail and drift allowance.spend, with its task written. Over Axiom (capxul-test, live) the same evals read what prove left there.

captions.01-fails-first-prove: The unit tests of watch and AxiomSource before the implementation: they fail.
captions.01-fails-first-cli: The CLI's watch test before the implementation: it fails.
captions.02-prove-tests: The same tests after: a healthy window, drift and its task, prove's calls left out, a defect, a replayed call, too few calls, an empty window, AxiomSource against a stand-in.
captions.03-cli-tests: architect watch as a command over the staging telemetry folder, and its refusals.
captions.04-axiom-live: watch over Axiom's query API on capxul-test, behind ARCHITECT_LIVE_AXIOM=1.
captions.05-staging-replay: Check 8's watch half against a real staging world: p95 against budget, refusal counts, drift none, then the slow handler as drift.
